## TL;DR

The current worktree at `921ee8eadad310937d717decf903ef32e15ee28a` contains the macOS Hub QA record and the XCTest registry isolation fixes. This report documents that current source and the check being run for this handoff. Signed-in Projects and Tasks remain unverified: human follow-up #1174 has no results, and the isolated Hub still requires email-code sign-in.

## Work and rationale

The QA pass built the macOS Hub using Xcode with signing disabled and a task-specific DerivedData directory. It launched the app through LaunchServices with a dedicated support directory and verified the first-run empty state, server discovery, a healthy local server connection, registry persistence, and rendering of the sign-in page. Window-only captures were used. The QA record lists what was tested, what was fixed, and the screens that could not be reached.

The XCTest app host had previously used the normal application-support registry when no override was set. That could mutate a developer's real Hub data. The change now gives XCTest a unique temporary support directory unless an explicit test override is provided, removes it when the app host terminates, logs cleanup failures, and tests both cleanup and error propagation. The QA record preserves the earlier registry write and its unknown prior selection rather than guessing at restoration.

## Approaches tried

The app was built and launched with isolated storage, then inspected through the native window and accessibility tree. The add-server flow discovered the local RepoOS server and showed it as healthy after connection. A direct-executable launch was also observed; no content window appeared during the short observation interval, so this remains an unexplained edge case rather than a confirmed crash. Automated email-code interaction did not reach authenticated pages. No immutable `work/reports/1169/` artifacts were edited by hand.

## Challenges and blockers

Authenticated Projects and Tasks require a person to complete the authorized email-code sign-in and record both screen results in #1174. That human-assigned task remains without results. The Hub is still at the code-entry screen, so this report does not claim those acceptance criteria are complete. Other untested areas and the prior registry incident remain documented in the QA record.

The requested `repoos check` is being run against this worktree before handoff. RepoOS will generate the report metadata and change summary from the checked source after the handoff gate passes.

## Key learnings

A successful sign-in-page render verifies connection and web rendering, not authenticated app functionality. Human sign-in observations must remain explicit until reported. XCTest app-host processes need isolated storage so tests cannot silently affect a developer's registry. Engineering report drafts must be recreated for each handoff because RepoOS consumes them into immutable round reports.
